verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents per-card amount ceilings on virtual cards, plus adjustable but unspecified 'controls' and a time window on CUSTOM VCNs, so the amount part of the story has thin support. Category and merchant restrictions are not documented: purpose-specific cards ('one card per supplier', travel/software/ads cards) are usage labels, not enforced restrictions. Point-of-sale auto-decline or auto-lock of out-of-policy spend is also not shown; manual block/unblock is only an adjacent control. Missing for 10: documented category/MCC restrictions, merchant allow/block lists, automatic decline or lock at point of sale, explicit description of what the VCN 'controls' are, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale

citations.quote: For CUSTOM, Update VCN tops up the ceiling, extends or shortens the window and adjusts the controls, without replacing the card.
Emita cartões virtuais em 1 clique, com limite certo para cada objetivo.
